div.h1: About Annapurna Tour and Travels LLP
div.p: Your trusted partner for comfortable and reliable travel experiences since 1990
Established in 1990 in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, Annapurna Travels has been serving customers with dedication and commitment for over three decades.

Founded by Mr. Narendra Kumar Ratnawat, our company started with a simple vision: to provide safe, comfortable, and reliable transportation services that exceed customer expectations. From humble beginnings with a single bus, we have grown into Central India's leading luxury coach rental company.

In 2022, marking a significant milestone in our journey, we restructured our business and officially became Annapurna Tour and Travels LLP. This transformation reflects our commitment to professional excellence and sustainable growth while maintaining the values and customer-centric approach that have defined us for over 30 years.

What sets us apart is our unwavering commitment to passenger comfort and safety. We have always believed that travel should be an experience to remember, not an ordeal to endure. This philosophy has guided us through our journey of growth and success, from Annapurna Travels to Annapurna Tour and Travels LLP.

From Annapurna Travels in 1990 to Annapurna Tour and Travels LLP in 2022, we continue to uphold honest and transparent business practices. Our pricing is fair, our commitments are reliable, and our communication is always truthful.
The principles that guide everything we do
Your safety is our top priority. We maintain the highest safety standards in all aspects of our service delivery.
We treat every customer like family, providing personalized service that goes beyond expectations.
We believe in honest and transparent business practices. Our pricing is fair, our commitments are reliable, and our communication is always truthful.
Punctuality and dependability are hallmarks of our service. We understand the importance of being on time for your important moments.
We are committed to environmental responsibility through fuel-efficient vehicles and sustainable business practices for a greener future.
We continuously strive for excellence in every aspect of our service, from vehicle maintenance to customer interaction.

Product must be returned to us within the specified number of days from the date it has been delivered to the customer. Product must be returned with all tags attached in its original condition along with all packing material, courier receipt, invoice & other papers.
Once the Product is received to the company successfully, Annapurna Tour and Travels LLP will instantly initiate the refund to your source account or chosen method of refund.
Refund and Cancellation for Service Provider Company:
Due to service providers in nature "NO REFUND", "NO CANCELLATION" will be entertained once the Payment has been made.

Please note an order can only be canceled within 24 hours of placing the order. Once the order is processed after 24 hours, no cancellation request will be entertained. However return is possible for all orders/products.

Customers can CANCEL order only before the Order has been shipped/Dispatched. After the Product/s have been shipped, The Customer CANNOT Cancel the Orders. However return is possible for all orders/products.
Annapurna Tour and Travels LLP ships its products to almost all parts of India. Orders placed will be shipped within 24 hrs. We ship on all days except Sunday and National Holidays.

For all areas serviced by reputed couriers, the delivery time would be within 3 to 4 business days of shipping (business days exclude Sundays and other holidays). For other areas the products will be shipped through standard courier and may take 1-2 weeks depending on location.

We use data collection devices such as "cookies" on certain pages of the Site to help and analyze our web page flow, measure promotional effectiveness, and promote trust and safety.

"Cookies" are small files placed on your hard drive that assist us in providing our services. We offer certain features that are only available through the use of a "cookie". Cookies can also help us provide information that is targeted to your interests. Most cookies are "session cookies," which means that they are automatically deleted from your hard drive at the end of a session. You are always free to decline our cookies if your browser permits.

Additionally, you may encounter "cookies" or other similar devices on certain pages of the Site that are placed by third parties. For example, if you view a web page created by a user, there may be a "cookie" placed within that web page. We do not control the use of cookies by third parties.

You acknowledge that you are disclosing Personal Information voluntarily. We identify and use your IP address to help diagnose problems with our server, and to administer our Website. Your IP address is also used to help identify you and to gather broad demographic information.
Annapurna Tour and Travels LLP operates a strict privacy policy and we are committed to being transparent about how we use cookies on our website.

Cookies help you make your online experience more efficient and relevant to your interests. For instance, they are used to remember your preferences on sites you visit often, to remember your user ID and the contents of your shopping baskets, and to help you navigate between pages efficiently.

A cookie is a small file, or files on your computer, phone, or other device with a browser to save snippets of text for reference by the website you are visiting. All cookies have expiration dates in them that determine how long they stay in your browser:

ul.li: Session cookies - these are temporary cookies that expire (and are automatically erased) whenever you close your browser.

Persistent cookies - these usually have an expiration date and so stay in your browser until they expire, or until you manually delete them. For example we use persistent cookies to better understand usage patterns so that we can improve the site for our customers.

div.p: Cookies are grouped into the following categories:

ul.li: Essential - these are cookies that are required for the regular operation of our websites.
Functional - these remember your preferences, and are intended to make your experience on our websites better for you.

Analytics - these cookies are used for performance measurement to understand things including how many people visit our websites, how they navigate our sites, and what content is popular. This allows us to improve your experience with us. Additionally, you can see how Google Analytics (one of our analytics tools) uses cookie information when you use our partners' sites by visiting www.google.com/policies/privacy/partners.

Advertising - these cookies enable us and our advertising partners to serve you with relevant advertisements that we think will interest you. You might see these advertisements on our sites on other sites you visit. These cookies record your visit to our website and the content you interact with. They may be placed by us, or by advertising partners with our permission.

div.p: To ensure compliance with our policies, we restrict the use of third-party cookies to trusted partners. We also use third party information from third party sources to enable us deliver advertising. These sources are validated by Third party, and not by us.
